_about: Tables for science/TECHNOLOGY.md, DISCOVERY.md, JOURNAL.md and PLAN.md: the availability layer, the discovery states, the journal's classifications and entry fields, the separations, and the development plan. Rex (2026-10-29): the journal records everything encountered; discoveries made with the period's equipment before their historical date are Time Anomalies; the limiter is the equipment, never the chemical; the world is ours in a space-time anomaly version. mark: rex | proposed | open. Tables moved whole to data/library/science.json (no game columns): states, entry.

separations.source: ChatGPT's list (outside AI), which Rex adopted in his own words: the chemistry is not limited by the period; the equipment is the limiter; a discovery out of its time is a time anomaly in the journal.
